title: PRs into LIVE merge by themselves once the auditor CLEARs the head and CI is green (audit gate)
decision: A pull_request_target workflow (.github/workflows/audit-gate.yml) runs scripts/audit_gate.py from the base branch only. It merges a PR into LIVE when (1) the latest trusted, unedited (OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR) verdict comment is `AUDIT CLEAR <40-hex head sha> [merge|squash]` with no later `AUDIT HOLD`, (2) that sha is the head or the head's diff from its merge-base with LIVE has byte-identical diff bytes (sha256 of git diff --binary --full-index from the merge-base; not git patch-id, which ignores whitespace -- #445 audit MF1), so a clean merge-in of LIVE that leaves the PR's files' context untouched keeps the CLEAR and anything else needs a new one; the verdict is re-read on every CI poll and right before the merge (MF2), and any edited trusted comment counts as a HOLD at its edit time (only a new CLEAR comment lifts it), (3) every CI check run on the head finished with none failed and quality, mt5-money-path and coverage-floor succeeded, and (4) the PR is from this repository. It then marks a draft ready, merges via REST pinned to the head sha, and dispatches ci.yml on LIVE; ci.yml's seal and promote jobs and its concurrency group now treat workflow_dispatch like push, because a merge made with the workflow token starts no push run. A run is started by adding the label audit-clear (which the gate removes) and by every push. No branch protection and no repo setting is used.
why: zuck 2026-10-28 13:51Z: 'i want this to fully auto merge without me after these'. Every merge was a pasted gh block because an agent's own merge is refused. GitHub auto-merge would need branch protection to wait on anything, and required checks on LIVE would refuse the CI seal job's own push (github-actions is no admin) and the box's state publish. Audit HOLD still beats green CI: nothing merges without a CLEAR of the exact change.

title: The box needs nobody after a reboot, and workflow-file PRs merge from the box
decision: (1) REBOOT: the MT5 terminals need a logged-on desktop (the MetaTrader5 API reaches a terminal only from its interactive session; Session 0 / S4U / 'run whether logged on or not' fails -10004), so the fix is Windows auto-logon, set once by zuck with Microsoft's Sysinternals Autologon (password kept as an LSA secret, never seen or stored by us). ops/box/install_unattended.ps1 registers Quant-BootSession (at logon: start the MT5 terminals recorded as running before the reboot, never Fusion which ensure_terminal owns, never a second copy in any session; lock the console session), Quant-BootRecord (every 10 min, records the running terminals, not in the first 15 min after boot) and reports auto-logon readiness read-only (plain-text DefaultPassword, AutoLogonCount and logon banner flagged). (2) CLAUDE SIGN-IN cannot be fully automated: `claude setup-token` gives a 1-year token for model requests only and cannot run Remote Control; the normal /login refreshes itself and needs a person only if the refresh fails. (3) WORKFLOW-FILE PRs: .github/scripts/audit_gate.py gains a box mode; the Actions run leaves a .github/workflows PR pending ('the box merges this') and Quant-WorkflowGate runs `audit_gate.py --sweep --box` every 10 min from a clean detached checkout of origin/LIVE with zuck's gh login (GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN dropped), merging only workflow-file PRs under the same rule (CLEAR of the exact change, latest verdict, green gating CI, pinned to the head sha), never waiting and dispatching nothing (a user-token merge starts push CI). Without the workflow scope it merges nothing and says so. Amended 2026-10-28 16:05Z (Desk health: the cloud sessions are refused adding the audit-clear label and marking a draft ready): the box sweep looks at EVERY open PR into LIVE, needs no label, marks a CLEARed draft ready itself, posts no pending status, and without the workflow scope still merges the non-workflow PRs and reports the missing scope. Amended 2026-10-28 18:50Z (zuck: 'Fine do one tap a day'): no merge, from the box or Actions, without zuck's own comment `APPROVE MERGES` on issue #453 posted AFTER the auditor's CLEAR it covers (OWNER, not posted through any GitHub App, never edited). One comment approves every CLEAR already given; later CLEARs wait for the next. Claude never posts it.

title: Release controller step D: zero API cost -- replay shadow in Actions, free-model reviewer, queued retries
decision: zuck 2026-10-28 19:47Z: no paid API keys, no recurring cost. (1) replay-shadow (release-gates.yml, ops/release/replay_shadow.py + replay_child.py): the live E8 gold book (prop.e8_gold.run, unarmed, terminal and venue faked) on base and PR trees over 90 scenarios x 14 server hours (1260 steps); any changed decision, a PR-side crash, an unimported money-path change or a base that places nothing FAILS; prose and wall-clock fields are not decisions. (2) independent-review asks only free models: OpenRouter ':free' ids through OPENROUTER_FREE_KEY, which must carry a $0 spending cap (checked each run; a key that can spend is refused), and Gemini through GEMINI_FREE_KEY from a no-billing project; PASS needs 2 passes from 2 families (no Anthropic), one FAIL is final. (3) No model answering = UNAVAILABLE (exit 75 + REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE annotation): the controller keeps the PR pending, never quarantined or merged, and re-runs the job after 20 min (cap 48 attempts) from whichever gate run looks next (box sweep or an event) -- no new scheduler. REVIEWER_API_KEY is dropped.
why: Deterministic gates carry the weight at zero cost (Actions is free on standard runners for a public repo); free reviewers add an independent read without spend; a missing review queues instead of bypassing.
limits: The PR's code runs in the replay child that writes its own result, so a PR written to fool the shadow can; that is the reviewer's job. The grid covers the E8 gold book only: Fusion gateway and other books are unmeasured money paths and always take the manual path. Free-tier limits (OpenRouter 50/day under 10 credits) are shared with the desk's other free callers.

title: Release controller step D: keyless reviewer -- open-weight models on the Actions runner
decision: zuck 2026-10-28 23:44Z: no new key to add. independent-review runs its own reviewers on the ubuntu runner: an Ollama release archive run only when its sha256 matches the pin in ops/release/local_models.json (no install script, no sudo, served as the runner user), serving qwen2.5-coder:7b (qwen) and llama3.1:8b (meta-llama), each asked only when the sha256 of its manifest file on disk (hashed by the reviewer, not reported by the server) matches its pin. Pins are null until a follow-up PR sets them from the values a run prints; until then nothing runs and reviews queue. The diff is never reviewed in parts: a prompt that does not fit enough families whole (2 chars/token estimate, num_ctx 32768) FAILS to the manual path, and an answer whose prompt_eval_count shows truncation is unreadable (one retry, then FAIL). The OpenRouter/Gemini free-key rungs stay optional and are never asked for. The box key and box-posted statuses are not used: the verdict stays inside the Actions check the controller trusts, never under the owner's login.
why: Zero keys and zero spend with no owner step; the verdict's provenance stays GitHub-issued; nothing new runs on the box or as zuck.
limits: 7-8B models on 4 CPUs are much weaker reviewers than hosted frontier models; the replay, knob rule and risk-invariants carry most of the weight, and the mutation/injection canary must show both local models FAILing before ACTIVATE LIVE AUTO-MERGE. Diffs over ~58k characters always take the manual path.

title: Unattended adopter: auditor-CLEAR code only, trade-window blackout, smoke + health, automatic rollback
decision: Adopt-And-Seal runs scripts/adopt_guard.py: pre (every code path the target changes must carry a blob an effective auditor CLEAR row in desks/mt5/data/ADOPT_CLEARS.jsonl vouches for; HOLD revokes; append-only; no rolled-back blobs; no start inside 03:30-04:30Z or the 120 min before it), smoke (live entry modules import, prestart_check.py if present), blackout re-check before the seal, health after recycle (release identity allows new risk under the new seal; gateway passes again if it was alive), and on any failure rolls code + IMMUTABLE_MANIFEST + RELEASE.json back in place to the pre-run commit and records the rolled-back blobs so they are not re-adopted. A failed rollback pauses new risk (GATEWAY_PAUSED by adopt_guard) and a later healthy run lifts only that pause. MT5-AdoptRelease is re-enabled once this lands.
why: zuck ordered one automated, tested deploy path to the box with automatic rollback so live never depends on the laptop or a hand step (10-28 05:22Z, after the 10-28 gold trades were missed because the laptop sitting stalled). The adopter existed but sat disabled because it trusted green CI only, could land inside the gold window, and had no way back. Trade-off: anyone with commit rights can append a CLEAR row (same residual as sign_train); a blob cleared in one commit is accepted in another.

title: Unattended adopter v2: new-risk hold on every lane, gateway load stamp, broker-clock blackouts, rollback on every post-write failure
decision: Answers the auditor HOLD on adopter v1. A failed adoption's rollback puts up libs/ops/new_risk_hold (desks/mt5/data/ADOPT_NEW_RISK_HOLD.json, box-local, O_EXCL, lifted only by its writer) that the gateway (NEW_RISK_OK), E8 executor, E8 gold and FTMO follower read before opening; management, cancels and flattens keep running; GATEWAY_PAUSED is no longer used. Only a health check against the restored seal lifts it (right after the rollback or the one-look heal at the start of a later run); a failed rollback or an unhealthy restored release pages and exits 12. Health now requires a resident gateway STARTED after the recycle that stamps the new release and a finished pass (GATEWAY_LOADED.json) and no failed live lane task. Blackouts are on the broker clock for asia, london_am and afternoon. Governed paths add scripts by suffix and origin-changed money config; policy can only widen. Clears vouch per (path, blob) and a HOLD revokes by commit and by blob. Every failure after the first write goes through Undo-Adoption; HEAD is re-read under the mutex.
why: The v1 audit found a pause that stopped management while the E8 and FTMO lanes kept trading, a health check satisfied by a gateway still on the old code, a UTC blackout that would have opened gold Asia to adoption from 2026-11-01, uncovered money config, a HOLD that a broader CLEAR could outvote, and post-write failures that left a half-adopted tree. Trade-off: the adopter is idle about 9 of 24 hours (120-minute start margin before each gold window), and the hold can block new entries for up to an hour if the restored release is slow to prove healthy.

title: Unattended adopter v3: hold before the first write, unsealed box code needs a CLEAR, the hold billed as a veto
decision: Answers the auditor HOLD on adopter v2. Adopt-And-Seal writes the new-risk hold before Adopt-Release writes a byte (no hold, no adoption) and lifts it only on a passing health check, a later run's heal, or the three exits where nothing was adopted; a heal that still finds the guard's hold after 90 minutes on an unhealthy release pages. Governed code is compared with the last sealed release, never HEAD, so code a box session committed unsealed needs a CLEAR. E8 gold's failed-leg retry obeys the hold. The hold is billed as the veto adopt_new_risk_hold (gateway rails ledger once per hold per day, E8 executor and E8 gold RAIL_BLOCKED rows, FTMO follower under its own rail by reason) and carried in missed_growth. The resident gateway rewrites its whole load stamp every pass and logs a failed write. Holds are one file per writer, so the guard's stands beside a person's. UNIVERSAL_SURVIVORS.json and markout.json are governed despite their evidence prefix. A rollback unstages a partial adoption's leftover index entries.
why: The v2 audit found that a run killed by the task limit between the first write and the health check left E8 and FTMO trading a half-written tree unheld; that code already on the box branch skipped the CLEAR check; that a gold retry ignored the hold; that the hold was an unbilled veto (Rule 1); and that one lost start stamp failed health for a resident's whole life. Trade-off: every adoption now holds new entries for its few minutes (outside the gold-window blackouts) and that time is billed.

title: Adopter v4: box-local switches (GOLD_OCO_MODE.json) flipped by the adopter, with no typed confirmation
decision: A switch committed under desks/mt5/data/box_state_desired/<NAME> (governed state, so pre requires an auditor CLEAR for its blob, re-checked against HEAD's CLEAR rows) is written to desks/mt5/data/<NAME> by libs/ops/desired_state.py, called from Adopt-And-Seal on every healthy exit (already-sealed, accepts-nothing-to-seal, sealed). Only names with a check are applied (today GOLD_OCO_MODE.json: known lanes, e8 present, modes name listed lanes as oco/fallback, and every ADDED lane already publishes a readable gold state on the current protocol, since gold_oco freezes all gold while a listed lane is silent). Never inside the blackout or its 120 min start margin, never while the adopter's own hold stands. Under its own new-risk hold (box_state) the live copy is backed up, written atomically and journaled in reports/BOX_STATE_APPLIED.jsonl; every lane task that runs within 7 min must exit 0, else the backup is put back (or the file removed), pages, and the hold stays until lanes pass. A refused switch pages once per content.
why: zuck 2026-10-28 06:43Z: no typed confirmations; the box should act by itself. Adopts were already unattended once v3 lands, but box-state flips such as the FTMO gold lane still waited on a typed 'yes'. Trade-off: each applied switch holds new entries for up to ~7 min outside the gold windows, billed as adopt_new_risk_hold.

title: Adopter v5: a hold is lifted only by the run that placed it or by health; heal first and on the running gateway; hold only when something governed changes; per-pass gateway stamps its load
decision: Answers the auditor HOLD on v3. MF1: holds carry the placing run's id and a nothing-landed exit lifts only its own (a failed rollback's hold stays until health passes); those exits refuse to lift over dirty code and roll back instead. MF2: heal runs straight after the mutex, before the release gate, and accepts a gateway on the sealed release that finished a pass after the hold, but never over code on disk that differs from HEAD. MF3: the hold goes up only when pre finds governed paths (needs_hold). Any file in new_risk_holds/ holds. Desk health 10-28: MT5-GatewayResident is disabled and MT5-Gateway (run_gateway_loop, one process per pass) is the live runner, which never read GATEWAY_RECYCLE nor stamped GATEWAY_LOADED; run_gateway_loop now writes the same load stamp after a finished pass, so health sees the new code without a recycle.
why: v3 audit: a nothing-landed lift could free a failed rollback's hold and let E8/FTMO trade a mixed tree; a kill before any write left all lanes held for as long as the gate held; every hourly run held all lanes even with nothing governed changing (Rule 1). Without the per-pass stamp every good adoption would have been rolled back on the box as it runs today.

title: Adopter v6: box switches applied once per version, no hold, provisional until a gold window ran on them; a running task is not a failed one
decision: Answers the auditor HOLD on v4. lane_problems/task_verdict treat Task Scheduler 267009 (running) and 267011 (never ran) as not finished. desired_state applies each committed version once (journal keyed by blob, written before the switch; a person's later edit stands), takes no new-risk hold (Rule 1), records each touched lane's pre-switch state and judges only lanes healthy before, and keeps the switch PROVISIONAL with its restore armed: state-verify runs every adopter run (right after heal, gold windows included) and puts the old switch back when a judged lane finished a run nonzero or a lane the switch added stops publishing (gold frozen everywhere). It is confirmed after the first gold window following it ended with every judged lane's latest run since the window opened exiting 0, or 24 h after that window with no failure seen. Gold lane tasks come from policy gold_lane_tasks (E8-Gold, MT5-Gateway for Fusion, MT5-FTMO-Follower); MT5-Gateway joins the health lane tasks.
why: v4 audit: running tasks read as failures and rolled back good changes; seven minutes outside a window proved nothing about a gold switch; a lane already down rolled back a good switch and held every lane; the committed switch rewrote a person's incident edit every hour.

title: Cancel requests: a supported lever for every executor to withdraw its own resting orders, applicable by the unattended adopter
decision: mt5desk/cancel_pending.py reads box-local desks/mt5/data/CANCEL_PENDING.json (requests: id, lane e8|fusion|ftmo, tickets or all, expires_at at most 48 h out, why). The FTMO follower (MAGIC orders), E8 gold (its journalled entries and window legs) and the gateway (MAGIC orders, lane fusion, removal confirmed against orders_get) cancel only their OWN resting orders named by a live request, only when armed, and record each outcome in data/cancel_pending_acks/<lane>.json so a cancelled ticket is not re-sent and a failed one is retried. 'all' cancels the orders resting when the lane first saw the request (a snapshot, never a standing veto). Nothing is opened or closed. desired_state adds CANCEL_PENDING.json as an ANY_TIME switch: checked, applied once per committed version even inside a gold window or under the adopter's hold (it only reduces exposure), never provisional; state-verify, which runs first every adopter run, applies it.
why: 2026-10-28 Desk health: no executor had a lever to withdraw a resting order, so zuck was asked to delete FTMO ticket 111616773 by hand in the terminal.

title: Adopter v8: confirm a box switch only on in-window evidence; never undeclare a lane holding gold
decision: Answers the auditor HOLD on v6. MF1: a provisional switch is CONFIRMED only when every touched lane task is seen OK by a verify running inside the gold window; otherwise the window rolls. MF2: before a restore each added lane's last state is read at any age, and unknown or holding positions/orders means no restore and one page. Should-fixes: gold_lane_tasks additions-only, added lane fresher than 600 s, APPLYING retried, hold when the target rewrites code HEAD runs, untracked code counts as dirty, gateway loop stamps only after a saved pass.
why: Auditor HOLD on adopter v6 (tree 30fb697c): confirm without evidence violated L1.28a, and a restore could undeclare a lane that holds gold.

title: Adopter v9: every requested cancel billed, cancel acks fail closed, all bounded by order time, switches confirm on the gateway's pass stamp and stop being reversible after a day
decision: Answers the auditor HOLD on v7+v8 (tree 19bb06e7). MF1: the gateway test harness stubs cancel_requested. MF2: each executor bills a withdrawn order as RAIL_BLOCKED cancel_requested at its own risk (fusion_rails and E8 intents; FTMO rail ftmo_follower reason cancel_requested); the rail is registered in fusion_rails.RAILS and missed_growth. MF3: check_cancel_pending returns str|None. MF4: this row and 038 carry title, why, by and evidence. MF5: MT5-Gateway counts as seen in a window by its GATEWAY_LOADED pass stamp; after the 24 h page a switch is KEPT_UNCONFIRMED and its restore disarmed; a newer CLEARed version supersedes a provisional one, restoring to the state before both. MF6: a garbled ack file cancels nothing; all requires placed_before and takes only orders whose own setup time (broker clock to UTC) is at or before it and before first sight. Should-fixes: gateway acks only on a done retcode; verify and cancel apply run independently; the busy page no longer claims gold is frozen.
why: Auditor HOLD on adopter v7+v8 with six must-fixes (report reports/audit/2026-10-14/AUTO_DEPLOY_V1_d2ecbf7ad.md v7+v8 section).

decision: hold_new_risk records the untracked code under the code roots (desks/mt5/data/ADOPT_UNTRACKED_BASELINE.json, box-local) before this guard's first hold goes up; a hold already standing keeps its record. code_dirty counts tracked code differing from HEAD plus untracked code NOT in that record; no readable record means every untracked code file counts (fail closed). The record never delays the hold.

title: Adopter v11: switches confirm and disarm only on trading-day windows; a superseding version is measured against what it restores to; the strays record is path plus content
decision: Answers the auditor HOLD on v10 (tree f99a18bc). MF1: next_window skips broker Saturdays and Sundays (closed market), and the unconfirmed page and disarm count UNCONFIRMED_WINDOWS=3 trading gold windows, not 24 h. MF2: a superseding version's touched tasks and added lanes are computed against the backup its restore goes back to (the state before both), so a lane an older version added stays busy-checked. MF3: ADOPT_UNTRACKED_BASELINE records path and sha256; a rewritten stray counts. Should-fixes: the gateway stamp counts only from the release the switch was applied under; a record with no hold of ours stands (a hand-deleted hold never absorbs a failed adoption's files) and each lift of the last hold removes it; the record is gitignored; E8 order stamps are read as UTC, the conservative reading whichever clock the venue uses.

title: A removed or paused gold lane withdraws its own resting entries, with no request
decision: mt5desk.cancel_pending.withdraw_reason(lane, armed) is applied by every executor on every pass, before its other order management: a non-leader lane not declared in GOLD_OCO_MODE.json (removed, or the file unreadable/absent, which reads as the default lanes), or a lane that is not armed, withdraws every own resting gold entry. The FTMO follower and E8 send the cancel even when unarmed (a cancel opens nothing; the order door classes it risk-reducing). The gateway withdraws only its MAGIC XAUUSD pending orders and keys the pause on st['armed'] alone, never on the adopter's new-risk hold. Each withdrawal is confirmed (FTMO/gateway: done retcode, gateway also absence) and billed per order as RAIL_BLOCKED, rail cancel_requested, reason lane_withdrawn, at the order's own risk. Nothing is added to the adopter: the rule reads the live mode file and arm, so it holds for an adopter switch and a hand edit alike.
why: FTMO's resting SELL LIMIT 111616773 filled before its 10:00Z self-cancel, three hours after ftmo was removed from GOLD_OCO_MODE's lanes at 07:06Z for the cross-firm copy ban. The gate refused new FTMO orders but nothing withdrew the one already resting, so FTMO came to hold the same 0.32 gold short as E8. Positions are NOT closed by this rule (only resting entries); an FTMO position already filled is Desk health's call.

title: The FTMO prop fills ledger records hand and external closes; FTMO equity is kept in state

title: Lane withdraw: an unmeasured read never cancels (v14 audit MF1, MF2)
decision: cancel_pending.withdraw_check(lane, armed) returns (withdraw, unmeasured). Only a positively read lanes list that omits the lane, or an absent mode file (documented as the default lanes), withdraws; a present file that is unreadable (torn, sharing violation, AV lock) or has no lanes list keeps the orders and reports UNMEASURED. The arm is read on its own, so a pause still withdraws. gateway.load_state marks the absent state's default disarm (armed_default, cleared once a human arms); withdraw_lane_gold treats that disarm as UNMEASURED, cancels nothing, and bills one UNMEASURED cancel_requested/lane_withdrawn rails line a day. FTMO also confirms a withdrawal by the order's absence. FTMO bills under its own rail ftmo_follower with reason lane_withdrawn.
why: The v14 audit HOLD: a torn or locked GOLD_OCO_MODE.json read as the default lanes and withdrew a declared FTMO lane's entry, and the follower never re-places a placed window, so one bad read cost the day's trade; an absent gateway_state.json read as disarmed and withdrew every gold bracket. Missing or unreadable box state is UNMEASURED, not a declaration.

title: Heat is two-sided and uncapped: the flat 20% floor 24/7 and the fixed 30% cap are retired; survival rails stay
decision: (1) The 2026-10-06 two-sided rule (ALLOC-11, D-20261007-001; desks/mt5/research/heat_policy.py:83-104) governs the 20% target: heat_policy.resolve holds 20% only while the measured growth curve certifies it free (or the curve is unmeasured) and lets exposure fall toward cash when the curve says 20% gives up growth; check_absolute_ceiling's mandate condition and the heat invariant follow it. (2) There is no fixed cap on deployed heat: heat is the measured growth optimum within the measured survival bars. The fixed 30% (desks/mt5/mt5desk/gateway_config_fallback.py:105 HEAT_HARD_CEILING = 0.30, read as decision_core.MAX_HEAT_CEILING, as the solver's hard cap and as heat_policy's unmeasured fallback) is removed through the sealed sign path; when the growth curve is unmeasured the fallback is the 20% target. Firm and survival rails (E8/FTMO daily and max loss, the deadman, the survival ceiling, the catastrophe guard) are unchanged: a rail is not a cap.
